basis: committed Git blob content (git cat-file blob <blob-sha>)
note: Digests are computed over the COMMITTED BLOB, not the working-tree file. Because core.autocrlf=true, git normalises CRLF->LF when writing a blob, so files whose working-tree bytes were CRLF have a different blob digest from the Step 4 working-tree manifest. The EOL classification columns record git's own view (git ls-files --eol).
